ar: مريم
en: Sura 19: Maryam

p.src: 19:1  Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ كٓهيعٓصٓ
en: Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]
u.src: 19:1  Kāf Ha Ya ‘Ayyn Sād[1]

en: [1] See footnote 2:1

p.src: 19:2  This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,

ar: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
en: This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,
u.src: 19:2  This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah,

p.src: 19:3  When he called upon his Lord in private.

ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
en: When he called upon his Lord in private.
u.src: 19:3  When he called upon his Lord in private.

p.src: 19:4  He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[2] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
en: He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[2] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.
u.src: 19:4  He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head,[2] yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord.

en: [2] Lit., "ignited." The spread of white hair across the head is likened to igniting of fire in the bush.

p.src: 19:5  And I fear my kinsmen after me,[3] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,

ar: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
en: And I fear my kinsmen after me,[3] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,
u.src: 19:5  And I fear my kinsmen after me,[3] and my wife is barren; so grant me from Yourself an heir,

en: [3] i.e., my successors.

p.src: 19:6  who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”

ar: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
en: who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”
u.src: 19:6  who will inherit [prophethood] from me and from the house of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, well pleasing to You.”

p.src: 19:7  [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”

ar: يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
en: [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”
u.src: 19:7  [Allah said], “O Zachariah, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be John – a name that We have not given to anyone before.”

p.src: 19:8  He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
en: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”
u.src: 19:8  He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have reached an extremely old age?”

p.src: 19:9  [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”

ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
en: [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”
u.src: 19:9  [The angel] said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; I did create you before when you were nothing.’”

p.src: 19:10  Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[4] despite being sound.”

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
en: Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[4] despite being sound.”
u.src: 19:10  Zachariah said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not be able to speak to people for three nights,[4] despite being sound.”

en: [4] i.e., without being ill.

p.src: 19:11  Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
en: Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.
u.src: 19:11  Thereupon he came out to his people from the sanctuary and signaled to them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

p.src: 19:12  [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,

ar: يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
en: [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,
u.src: 19:12  [Allah said], “O John, hold the Scripture with all your strength.” And We gave him wisdom when he was still a child,

p.src: 19:13  as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,

ar: وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
en: as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,
u.src: 19:13  as We made him compassionate and righteous, and he was fearing Allah,

p.src: 19:14  and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.

ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
en: and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.
u.src: 19:14  and dutiful to his parents, and he was not an oppressor or disobedient.

p.src: 19:15  Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!

ar: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
en: Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!
u.src: 19:15  Peace be on him the day he was born, the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up to life again!

p.src: 19:16  And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.
u.src: 19:16  And mention in the Book [the story of] Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place towards the east.

p.src: 19:17  She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.

ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
en: She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.
u.src: 19:17  She screened herself from them, then We sent to her Our Spirit [Gabriel] and he appeared before her in the form of a perfect human being.

p.src: 19:18  She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”

ar: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
en: She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”
u.src: 19:18  She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you; [do not approach me] if you fear Allah.”

p.src: 19:19  He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”

ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًا زَكِيًّا
en: He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”
u.src: 19:19  He said, “I am only a messenger from your Lord to grant you a righteous son.”

p.src: 19:20  She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”

ar: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
en: She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”
u.src: 19:20  She said, “How can I have a son when no man has touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?”

p.src: 19:21  He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”

ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
en: He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”
u.src: 19:21  He said, “Thus it will be; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me; We make him a sign for people and a mercy from Us. This matter has already been decreed.’”

p.src: 19:22  So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[5]

ar: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
en: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[5]
u.src: 19:22  So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a distant place.[5]

en: [5] i.e., Bethlehem, around 6 miles (10 km) to the south of Jerusalem.

p.src: 19:23  The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”

ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
en: The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”
u.src: 19:23  The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, would that I had died before this and had been completely forgotten!”

p.src: 19:24  Then he[6] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.

ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
en: Then he[6] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.
u.src: 19:24  Then he[6] called her from beneath her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided a stream beneath you.

en: [6] i.e., the archangel Gabriel or the baby.

p.src: 19:25  Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.

ar: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
en: Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.
u.src: 19:25  Shake the trunk of the palm tree towards yourself; fresh ripe dates will drop upon you.

p.src: 19:26  Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[7] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”

ar: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
en: Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[7] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”
u.src: 19:26  Eat and drink, and be glad. And if you see any human being, say, ‘I have vowed silence[7] to the Most Compassionate, so I will not talk to any human being today.’”

en: [7] Sawm: literally means to abstain or fast from food, speech, etc.

p.src: 19:27  Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!

ar: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
en: Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!
u.src: 19:27  Then she came to her people carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have committed something monstrous!

p.src: 19:28  O sister of Aaron,[8] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”

ar: يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
en: O sister of Aaron,[8] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”
u.src: 19:28  O sister of Aaron,[8] your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”

en: [8] Aaron was a pious man at the time of Mary, or she was from the descendants of Aaron, Moses’ brother.

p.src: 19:29  Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”

ar: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
en: Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”
u.src: 19:29  Thereupon she pointed to him. They said, “How can we talk to someone who is still a baby in the cradle?”

p.src: 19:30  Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

ar: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
en: Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
u.src: 19:30  Jesus said, “I am a slave of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

p.src: 19:31  He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,

ar: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
en: He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,
u.src: 19:31  He has made me blessed wherever I may be, and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I am alive,

p.src: 19:32  and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.

ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
en: and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.
u.src: 19:32  and has made me dutiful to my mother, and has not made me an oppressor or disobedient.

p.src: 19:33  Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”

ar: وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
en: Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”
u.src: 19:33  Peace is upon me the day I was born, the day I will die and the day I will be resurrected.”

p.src: 19:34  Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.

ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
en: Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.
u.src: 19:34  Such was Jesus, son of Mary – a word of truth about which they are in doubt.

p.src: 19:35  It is not befitting for Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[9]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.

ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
en: It is not befitting for Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[9]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.
u.src: 19:35  It is not befitting for Allah to beget a son. Glory be to Him[9]! When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.

en: [9] i.e., far exalted is He above any such need.

p.src: 19:36  [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
en: [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”
u.src: 19:36  [Jesus said], “Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”

p.src: 19:37  But the factions differed among themselves[10] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!

ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: But the factions differed among themselves[10] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!
u.src: 19:37  But the factions differed among themselves[10] [about him]. So woe to the disbelievers from the scene of a momentous Day!

en: [10] Some believed that Jesus was God or the son of God, whereas those who truly followed him considered him only as Allah's messenger.

p.src: 19:38  How sharp they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.

ar: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: How sharp they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.
u.src: 19:38  How sharp they will hear and see on the Day they come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly misguided.

p.src: 19:39  Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.

ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.
u.src: 19:39  Warn them of the Day of Remorse when all matters will be decided, but they are heedless and they do not believe.

p.src: 19:40  It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
en: It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.
u.src: 19:40  It is We Who will inherit the earth and all those who are on it, and to Us they will be returned.

p.src: 19:41  And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.
u.src: 19:41  And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. He was indeed a man of truth and a prophet.

p.src: 19:42  When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
en: When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?
u.src: 19:42  When he said to his father, “O my dear father, why do you worship something that neither hears nor sees nor benefits you in any way?

p.src: 19:43  O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.

ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
en: O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.
u.src: 19:43  O my dear father, there has come to me some knowledge that has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to a straight path.

p.src: 19:44  O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا
en: O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.
u.src: 19:44  O my dear father, do not worship Satan. Indeed, Satan is rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

p.src: 19:45  O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”

ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا
en: O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”
u.src: 19:45  O my dear father, I truly fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate may afflict you and that you may become a companion of Satan [in Hell].”

p.src: 19:46  He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”

ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
en: He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”
u.src: 19:46  He said, “Are you turning away from my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you. Keep away from me for a long time!”

p.src: 19:47  Abraham said, “Peace be on you[11]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.

ar: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
en: Abraham said, “Peace be on you[11]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.
u.src: 19:47  Abraham said, “Peace be on you[11]. I will seek my Lord’s forgiveness for you. Indeed, He is Most Gracious to me.

en: [11] i.e., You are secure from me, so I will not harm you in the least.

p.src: 19:48  I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”

ar: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
en: I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”
u.src: 19:48  I will distance myself from you and from all that you supplicate besides Allah, and I will supplicate my Lord; perhaps my supplication to my Lord will not go unanswered.”

p.src: 19:49  When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.

ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
en: When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.
u.src: 19:49  When he distanced himself from them and what they worshiped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made each one of them a prophet.

p.src: 19:50  We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[12].

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
en: We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[12].
u.src: 19:50  We bestowed upon them of Our mercy and blessed them with a highly-esteemed reputation[12].

en: [12] As part of the prayer, Muslims invoke Allah’s blessings upon Muhammad (ﷺ) and his family and Abraham (ﷺ) and his family, on a daily basis.

p.src: 19:51  And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[13].

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[13].
u.src: 19:51  And mention in the Book [the story of] Moses. He was indeed a chosen one and was a messenger and a prophet[13].

en: [13] A messenger (rasūl) is one who was sent by Allah to reform society with a new law, such as Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, etc. A prophet (nabī) is one who is charged by Allah to reform society following the law of the messenger before him, such as Jacob, Isaac, Solomon, etc. Prophets are more numerous than messengers.

p.src: 19:52  We called him from the right side of Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.

ar: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا
en: We called him from the right side of Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.
u.src: 19:52  We called him from the right side of Mount Tūr [in Sinai] and We brought him near by conversing with him in private.

p.src: 19:53  And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
en: And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.
u.src: 19:53  And We granted him, by Our mercy, his brother Aaron, as a prophet.

p.src: 19:54  And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.
u.src: 19:54  And mention in the Book [the story of] Ishmael. He was true to his promise and was a messenger and a prophet.

p.src: 19:55  He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.

ar: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
en: He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
u.src: 19:55  He used to command his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was well pleased with him.

p.src: 19:56  And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[14]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.

ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[14]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.
u.src: 19:56  And mention in the Book [the story of] Idrīs[14]. He was a man of truth and a prophet.

en: [14] i.e., Prophet Enoch (عليه السلام).

p.src: 19:57  And We raised him to a high status[15].

ar: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
en: And We raised him to a high status[15].
u.src: 19:57  And We raised him to a high status[15].

en: [15] Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) met Prophet Idrīs (ﷺ) in the fourth heaven.

p.src: 19:58  These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.

ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
en: These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.
u.src: 19:58  These are the prophets whom Allah has favored from among the descendants of Adam, and from those whom We carried with Noah [in the Ark], and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and from those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the verses of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.

p.src: 19:59  But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[16],

ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
en: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[16],
u.src: 19:59  But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and pursued their desires; so they will meet their doom[16],

en: [16] i.e., a valley in Hell or the consequence of their evil deeds.

p.src: 19:60  except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
en: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.
u.src: 19:60  except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds – it is they who will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in the least.

p.src: 19:61  Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.

ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
en: Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.
u.src: 19:61  Gardens of Eternity which the Most Compassionate has promised His slaves who have not seen them. His promise will surely be fulfilled.

p.src: 19:62  They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[17].

ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
en: They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[17].
u.src: 19:62  They will not hear therein any idle talk, except greetings of peace, and they will have their provision morning and evening[17].

en: [17] Whenever they wish in a successive manner, not that there will be days and nights, rather they will know the elapse of time through lights and illuminations.

p.src: 19:63  Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.

ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
en: Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.
u.src: 19:63  Such is the Paradise which We will give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who feared Allah.

p.src: 19:64  [Gabriel said][18], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.

ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
en: [Gabriel said][18], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.
u.src: 19:64  [Gabriel said][18], “We do not descend except with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us, all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is never forgetful.

en: [18] In reply to the Prophet’s wish that Gabriel would visit him more frequently.

p.src: 19:65  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
en: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”
u.src: 19:65  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

p.src: 19:66  Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”

ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
en: Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”
u.src: 19:66  Man says, “Once I am dead, will I be raised to life again?”

p.src: 19:67  Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?

ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
en: Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?
u.src: 19:67  Does man not remember that We created him beforehand when he was nothing?

p.src: 19:68  By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[19].

ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
en: By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[19].
u.src: 19:68  By your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils, then We will surely bring them all around Hell on their knees[19].

en: [19] i.e., out of terror they will be on their knees or dragged unwillingly while on their knees.

p.src: 19:69  Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا
en: Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.
u.src: 19:69  Then We will surely drag out of every group those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate.

p.src: 19:70  For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.

ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
en: For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.
u.src: 19:70  For indeed We know best those who are most deserving to burn therein.

p.src: 19:71  There is none among you except that he will pass over it[20]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.

ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
en: There is none among you except that he will pass over it[20]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.
u.src: 19:71  There is none among you except that he will pass over it[20]; a decree from your Lord that must be fulfilled.

en: [20] Referring to the bridge of As-Sirāt, which is placed over Hell. Everyone will pass on it. The believers will cross it easily, each according to their faith, whereas the disbelievers and the hypocrites will fall into the Fire from the bridge.

p.src: 19:72  Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.

ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
en: Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.
u.src: 19:72  Then We will save those who fear Allah and will leave the wrongdoers in it on their knees.

p.src: 19:73  When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[21]

ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
en: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[21]
u.src: 19:73  When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two parties is better in terms of dwellings and superior in social gatherings?”[21]

en: [21] In regard to the life of this world.

p.src: 19:74  How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
en: How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!
u.src: 19:74  How many generations We have destroyed before them who were superior in terms of wealth and outward appearance!

p.src: 19:75  Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”

ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
en: Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”
u.src: 19:75  Say, “Whoever is following misguidance, the Most Compassionate will give him respite, until they see what they were warned of – be it the punishment [in this world] or the Hour – only then will they realize who is in a worse abode and who has a smaller following.”

p.src: 19:76  Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.

ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
en: Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.
u.src: 19:76  Allah increases in guidance those who are guided, and the righteous deeds of lasting merit are better with your Lord in reward and better in return.

p.src: 19:77  Have you seen the one[22] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”

ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
en: Have you seen the one[22] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”
u.src: 19:77  Have you seen the one[22] who rejects Our verses and says, “I will surely be given wealth and children [if I am resurrected]?”

en: [22] Al-‘Ās ibn Wāi’l, a staunch enemy of Islam in Makkah, not only disbelieved in resurrection; rather, he expected that he would be given wealth and children if resurrected.

p.src: 19:78  Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?

ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
en: Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?
u.src: 19:78  Has he obtained knowledge of the unseen, or has he taken a pledge with the Most Compassionate?

p.src: 19:79  Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.

ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
en: Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.
u.src: 19:79  Never! We will write down what he says and will prolong his punishment extensively.

p.src: 19:80  We will inherit what he boasts of[23], and he will come to Us all alone.

ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
en: We will inherit what he boasts of[23], and he will come to Us all alone.
u.src: 19:80  We will inherit what he boasts of[23], and he will come to Us all alone.

en: [23] He is falsely aspiring for wealth and children in the Hereafter, not only Allah will not give him anything in the Hereafter; rather, He will seize what he owned in the worldly life at the time of his death.

p.src: 19:81  They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].

ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
en: They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].
u.src: 19:81  They have taken gods other than Allah, in order that they may protect them [from punishment].

p.src: 19:82  Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.

ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
en: Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.
u.src: 19:82  Never! They will deny their worship and will become their enemies.

p.src: 19:83  Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
en: Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?
u.src: 19:83  Do you not see that We sent devils against the disbelievers constantly inciting them to sin?

p.src: 19:84  So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[24].

ar: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
en: So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[24].
u.src: 19:84  So do not be in haste about them; We are surely counting down their days[24].

en: [24] i.e., their breaths or evil deeds.

p.src: 19:85  The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,

ar: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا
en: The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,
u.src: 19:85  The Day when We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as honored guests,

p.src: 19:86  and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.

ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
en: and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.
u.src: 19:86  and We will drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd.

p.src: 19:87  None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[25].

ar: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
en: None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[25].
u.src: 19:87  None will have the power to intercede except those who have taken permission from the Most Compassionate[25].

en: [25] Through firmly believing in Him and worshiping Him alone.

p.src: 19:88  They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا
en: They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”
u.src: 19:88  They say, “The Most Compassionate has begotten a son.”

p.src: 19:89  You have made a monstrous statement,

ar: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
en: You have made a monstrous statement,
u.src: 19:89  You have made a monstrous statement,

p.src: 19:90  at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
en: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.
u.src: 19:90  at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

p.src: 19:91  because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

ar: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا
en: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.
u.src: 19:91  because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

p.src: 19:92  It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.

ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
en: It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.
u.src: 19:92  It is not appropriate for the Most Compassionate to beget a son.

p.src: 19:93  There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.

ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا
en: There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.
u.src: 19:93  There is none in the heavens and earth except that he will come to the Most Compassionate in full submission.

p.src: 19:94  He has counted them and numbered them precisely.

ar: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
en: He has counted them and numbered them precisely.
u.src: 19:94  He has counted them and numbered them precisely.

p.src: 19:95  Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.

ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
en: Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
u.src: 19:95  Each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.

p.src: 19:96  Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][26].

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا
en: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][26].
u.src: 19:96  Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Compassionate will endear them [to His creation][26].

en: [26] And He will love them as well.

p.src: 19:97  We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.

ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
en: We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.
u.src: 19:97  We have made this [Qur’an] easy in your language so that you may give thereby glad tidings to the righteous and warn people who are contentious.

p.src: 19:98  How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
en: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?
u.src: 19:98  How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you sense a single one of them or even hear from them a whisper?
